q1.explanationZh: 文章说，要请你吃真正的布丁时，英国人会“name the type”，就是说出布丁的种类，所以选 C。

evidence.quote: If they are going to serve you a real pudding, they will name

q2.explanationZh: 文章说以前“pudding”是容易做的甜点，比如 spotted dick 和米布丁，是下层阶级吃的，所以选 C。

evidence.quote: In the old days, “pudding” referred to easy-to-make desserts, like spotted dick

q3.explanationZh: 文章只说现在阶级的界线有点模糊，没有说英国已经没有阶级了，所以 B 不对。

evidence.quote: Today, class lines have become a little blurry

q4.explanationZh: 因为界线变模糊，食物不再和阶级紧紧连在一起，普通人也能吃到上层的甜点，所以 dessert 和 pudding 两个词也变模糊了。

evidence.quote: At the same time, it’s easier for everyday people to enjoy upper-class desserts.
